{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=05|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] [[Minister for Security]], [[Ben Wallace (politician)|Ben Wallace]], says he has reason to believe British photojournalist [[John Cantlie]] is still alive and is being held hostage by surviving [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State militants]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-47127902 (BBC)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**The [[Taliban]] kill over 40 people in three separate attacks while [[Afghanistan|Afghan]]-[[Taliban]] peace talks are taking place in [[Moscow]]. 12 others were injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/taliban-launch-deadly-attack-attend-afghan-peace-talks-190205085507913.html (Al Jazeera)]
**Two [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] journalists are killed by gunmen in an attack on a radio station in [[Taloqan]], [[Takhar province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-shooting/two-afghan-journalists-killed-as-gunmen-open-fire-in-radio-station-idUSKCN1PU1VZ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)]]
**A [[Burkina Faso|Burkinabé]] military operation reportedly kills 146 [[Jihadism|jihadist]]s after the [[Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb|Al-Qaeda]]-linked militants killed 14 people in other attacks. [https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/burkina-faso-forces-kill-146-jihadists-after-civilian-attack-20190205 (News24)]
*[[Central African Republic Civil War (2012–present)]]
**The Government of the [[Central African Republic]] sign a peace deal with 14 rebel groups. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/central-african-republic-initials-peace-deal-armed-groups-190205121250705.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Several homes have been damaged in an uncontrolled [[Wildfire|bushfire]] near the [[New Zealand]] city of [[Nelson, New Zealand|Nelson]]. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/110400124/live-large-forest-fire-in-nelson-intensifies (Stuff)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Eleven [[Lima Group]] member states support a declaration recognizing [[Juan Guaidó]] as interim [[President of Venezuela]], while three members of the Lima Group, [[Guyana]], [[Mexico]] and [[Saint Lucia]], did not back the declaration. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47126434 (BBC)]
**Portuguese bank [[Novo Banco]] blocks the transfer of $1.2 billion of Venezuelan government financial assets to [[Uruguay]]. The move was requested by the [[Nicolás Maduro]] government. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-funds-transfer-blocked-opposition-lawmaker-says-idUSKCN1PU2BV (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[February 2019 Paris fire]]
**A fire in an apartment block in [[Paris]], [[France]], kills ten and leaves over 30 wounded. The incident is being treated as possible [[arson]]. A woman was arrested on suspicion of setting the fire. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47126440 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/feb/05/paris-fire-deaths-blaze-in-eight-story-building-16th-arrondissement (The Guardian)]
*[[Pope Francis]] makes a public statement acknowledging that some priests and bishops in the Catholic Church have been sexually abusing nuns. [https://cbs6albany.com/news/nation-world/pope-acknowledges-priests-bishops-have-sexually-abused-nuns (CBS-6)] 

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 State of the Union Address]], [[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] delivers [[2019 State of the Union Address|his second State of the Union Address]] to the [[116th United States Congress]] in the chamber of [[United States House of Representatives|the House of Representatives]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2019/live-updates/trump-white-house/live-fact-checking-and-analysis-of-trumps-2019-state-of-the-union-address/?utm_term=.bfcfa1431a33 (The Washington Post)]
**A fundraising effort by Trump's 2020 campaign on the days leading to the address and on the day of the address raised $2.4 million from 76,000 donors. His campaign displayed names of donors on a live streaming broadcast of the event on Donald Trump's Facebook page. This is comparable to fundraising for Trump's 2020 campaign that occurred during the 2018 address that similarly included the display of names of donors on a streaming broadcast online. [https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/washington-secrets/trump-raises-2-4-million-from-76-000-in-sotu-pitch-a-new-record (Washington Examiner)]
*[[2019 North Korea–United States Vietnam Summit]], [[North Korea–United States relations]]
**During the State of the Union speech, President Trump announced he will meet with [[North Korea]]n leader [[Kim Jong-un]] in [[Vietnam]] on February 27 and 28. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/02/05/donald-trump-meet-north-koreas-kim-jong-un-vietnam/2771003002/ (''USA Today'')]
*Nationwide protests organised by the [[France|French]] [[Confédération Générale du Travail]] union attract over 18,000 people in [[Paris]], including many supporters of the [[Yellow vest movement]].  [https://www.france24.com/en/20190205-france-yellow-vest-protesters-join-union-march-cgt-paris-demonstration (France24)] [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/ap/article-6670507/Frances-yellow-vest-protesters-join-union-march-first.html (Daily Mail)]
